biotools.summary: MultiNMRFit is an open-source software designed for high-throughput analysis of one-dimensional NMR spectra, offering flexibility and reproducible results through fitting experimental spectra using built-in or user-defined signal models. It's accessible as a Python library and via a graphical user interface, supporting both novice and experienced users.
